title: Biomarker
description: A Cat-VRS CategoricalVariant whose allele, location, genes, function, and copy change are shaped into `constraints`. Root type `Biomarker` with one subtype per `biomarker_type` extension value.

Biomarker.description: Root type shared by every biomarker. Subtypes below are selected by the `biomarker_type` extension; the top-level schema closes the record.

orderKnown.description: True only when both partners are known.

Copy Number.description: Gene-level copy number change: a gene and a copy change.

Copy Number (arm level).description: Arm-level copy number change: a location and a copy change.

Gene fusion.description: Gene fusion, represented by a single AdjacencyConstraint. A fusion with one known partner has an UnspecifiedElement for the other.

Germline Variant.description: Germline variant: a location and a FeatureContextConstraint.

NonFusionRearrangement.description: Structural shape shared by `Rearrangement` and `Translocation`: a gene fusion's genes collapse into a single AdjacencyConstraint, while these use one FeatureContextConstraint per gene instead.

Protein expression.description: Protein expression, e.g. PD-L1 TPS >= 1%. No constraints.

Rearrangement.description: Chromosomal rearrangement that is neither a gene fusion nor a translocation (see `Gene fusion`, `Translocation`). Shares `NonFusionRearrangement`'s shape.

Translocation.description: Chromosomal translocation between one or two partner genes. Shares `NonFusionRearrangement`'s shape.

Somatic Variant.description: Somatic variant: a FeatureContextConstraint, plus an allele or location and optionally a function.

Tumor mutational burden.description: Tumor mutational burden classification. No constraints.

Wild type.description: Absence of variants in a gene: a location and a gene.
